v.NONA2A: Unmod. trans. morse ident. carrier emission continuous.
v.A8W: AM (unkeyed) plus ON/OFF keying of ident tone.
v.A9W: Composite AM/FM (unkeyed) plus ON/OFF keying of ident tone.

codeEmRdo.d: A code indicating the type of emission, as defined at the 1979 ITU World Administrative Radio Conference. E.G. : A3E, NONA2a, G1D.

v.HEAD: Head of state.
v.STATE: State aircraft. (Other than head of state).

codeFltStatus.d: A code indicating status of a flight.

codeFltType.d: A code indicating the type of a flight.

codeIapFix.d: A code indicating the role of a fix within an instrument approach procedure. Examples: initial approach fix, final approach fix, missed approach point, etc.

codeIdLvlClmn.d: A code identifying the column within a table of discreet cruising levels. E.g. east (000 to 179 degrees) or west (180 to 359 degrees) even.

codeIdLvlTbl.d: A code identifying the table of discreet cruising levels. Ex: ICAO IFR, ICAO VFR, ICAO RVSM, etc..

codeIntlRte.d: Code indicating if a route is international or domestic.

codeIntstLgt.d: A code indicating the light intensity. Eg: LIL, LIM, LIH, etc.

codeLang.d: A code indicating a language (according to ISO 639).

v.ICAO: The values refer to ICAO standards.
v.IATA: The values refer to IATA standards.
v.NATO: The values refer to NATO military standards.
v.FAA: The values refer to US FAA standards.

codeLovReference.d: A code indicating the standard referred to by a list of values, in case where different aviation authorities use different categorisation criteria.

codeLvl.d: A code indicating the level: upper airspace, lower airspace or both.

codeMil.d: A code distinguishing between military and civil status.

v.BASE: 'Parent' airspace is the basis for subsequent operations.
v.UNION: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in a union operation.
v.INTERS: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in intersection operation.
v.SUBTR: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in subtraction operation.

codeOpr.d: An 'operator' in coded form according to which two 'operants' will be 'associated' in order to produce a result.

v.UNION: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in a union operation.
v.INTERS: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in intersection operation.
v.SUBTR: 'Parent' airspace is second operand in subtraction operation.

codeOprAs.d: An 'operator' in coded form according to which the geometry of an airspace will contribute to the geometry of an aggregated airspace.

codeOrigin.d: A code indicating the origin with regard to international borders.

codePcnEvalMethod.d: A code indicating the method used in the evaluation of a PCN number.

codePcnPavementType.d: A code indicating the pavement behaviour (rigid or flexible) used for the PCN determination.

codePcnPavementSubgrade.d: A code indicating the subgrade strength category related to a PCN number.

v.X: Medium: Pressure limited to 1.5 MPa (217 psi).
v.Y: Low: Pressure limited to 1.00 MPa (145 psi).
v.Z: Very low: Pressure limited to 0.50 MPa (73 psi).

codePcnMaxTirePressure.d: A code indicating the maximum allowable tire pressure categoryrelated to a PCN number.

codePhaseProc.d: A code indicating a phase of a SID, STAR or IAP. Note: Some of the values apply only for a SID, other apply only for a STAR and other apply only for an IAP (the 'A' value).

codePreparationSfc.d: A code indicating the preparation technique for a surface area.

codePsnApron.d: A code indicating a location on the surface of an apron.

codePsnIls.d: A code indicating a position in the ILS system. E.g. outer, middle, inner, backcourse.

v.LEFT: On the left side of the axis.
v.RIGHT: On the right side of the axis.
v.BOTH: Distributed on both sides of the axis.

codePsnRelAxis.d: A code indicating a position, relative to the an axis. For example: left/right of a runway centreline.

codePsnRwy.d: A code indicating the position of an item on a surface of a runway. Eg: THR, runway end, runway centre line, TDZ, etc.

codePsnTlof.d: A code indicating the position of an item on the surface of a Touch Down and Lift-off Area.

codePsnTwy.d: A code indicating the position of an item on the surface of a taxiway.

codePurpose.d: A code indicating the purpose of a flight.

codeRefOch.d: A code indicating the reference position for the obstacle clearance height.

codeRepAtc.d: A code indicating the type of position report required by an ATC Unit. Eg.: compulsory or on request.

codeRteAvbl.d: A code indicating the route segment availability whether within the Flexible Use of Airspace concept or not.

codeRvsmPoint.d: A code indicating that the point has a specific role in the RVSM context.

codeSourceSer.d: A code indicating the source of the service type. The list of allowable values is open-ended.

codeSpecialDate.d: A code indicating the type of a special date, such as 'holiday', 'busy Friday', etc.

codeSpeedRef.d: A code indicating the reference system for a speed value.

codeStrengthSfc.d: [Deprecated] A code indicating the convention used to measure the strength of a surface. Eg: PCN, SIWL, etc..

codeStsSfc.d: A code indicating the operational status of a runway, taxiway, gate, parking position, FATO etc.. Eg: serviceable, unserviceable, closed, work in progress, etc..

codeTimeEvent.d: A code indicating an event occurrence during any day. Ex: sunrise, sunset.

codeTimeRef.d: A code indicating the time reference system: UTC or 'UTC adjustable for summer time'(the specified time is applicable during winter; during the summer time - daylight saving time - the value must be decreased by one hour).

codeTypeAcft.d: A code indicating the type of an aircraft

codeTypeAcftCap.d: A code indicating the type of equipment and certification of an aircraft for a specified capability; i.e.: RNAV, RVSM, etc.

codeTypeAcftEngine.d: A code indicating the type of aircarft engine (e.g., jet, piston, turbo).

codeTypeAddress.d: A code indicating the address type. Ex: postal address, phone number, fax number, AFS address, E-mail address, telex number, etc..

codeTypeAdHp.d: A code specifying whether a particular entity occurrence is an Aerodrome or a Heliport.

codeTypeAdHpClc.d: A code indicating the extent of collocation between an aerodrome and a heliport.

codeTypeAeroLgt.d: A code indicating a type of aeronautical ground light. Eg: Marine, RWY BCN, ABN, IBN, etc.

codeTypeAirspaceVertex.d: A code indicating the type of path to the next point of an airspace vertex, which is always a closed path. E.g. great circle, rhumbline, geoidal line, clockwise arc, counter clockwise arc, etc.

codeTypeAlsFato.d: A code indicating the type of approach lighting system of a FATO direction. Eg: ICAO CAT I, ICAO CAT II, simple approach lighting system.

codeTypeAlsRwy.d: A code indicating the type of approach lighting system of a runway direction. Eg: ICAO CAT I, ICAO CAT II, simple approach lighting system.

codeTypeAngleBrg.d: A code indicating the type of angle: magnetic, bearing, VOR radial.

codeTypeApchProc.d: A code indicating a type of approach procedure. Eg: straight-in, circling, straight-in CAT I, etc..

codeTypeAssocAs.d: The values indicating the type of association between two airspaces.

codeTypeAssocOrg.d: The values indicating the type of association between two organisations/authorities.

codeTypeAssocUnit.d: The values indicating the type of association between two units.

v.OWN: An authority has the legal right of possession and proprietorship over the feature.
v.DLGT: An authority is assigned or entrusted with the responsibility for that feature.
v.AIS: The organization is responsible for the provision of aeronautical information in relation with that feature.

codeTypeAsAuth.d: A code indicating the type of the responsability that one organisation/authority has for an airspace. Ex: The airspace is under the jurisdiction of Organization/Authority or the airspace is delegated to the Organization/Authority for the provision of air traffic services.

codeTypeAsSignpnt.d: A code indicating the type of association between a significant point and an airspace. E.g. entry point, exit point, etc..

codeTypeAzm.d: A code indicating the type of azimuth equipment: normal or backward.

codeTypeBorderVertex.d: A code indicating the type of path to the next point of a geographical border vertex (open polyline).

codeTypeClineVertex.d: A code indicating the type of path to the next point of a centreline, such as great circle or rhumbline.

codeTypeCourse.d: A code indicating the type of course to be observed. E.g. true track, magnetic track, heading, VOR radial, true bearing, magnetic bearing.

codeTypeDeclDistFato.d: A code indicating the type of conventional declared distance for a Final Approach and Take-Off Direction. Eg: LDAH, RTODAH, etc..

codeTypeDeclDistRwy.d: A code indicating the type of conventional declared distance for a runway. Eg: TORA, TODA, LDA, etc..

codeTypeDesigPt.d: A code indicating a specific type of designated point whether published by the State, published by ICAO or created by another agency for convenience of identification.

codeTypeDme.d: A code indicating the type of UHF distance measuring equipment.

codeTypeFltRule.d: Flight rules to be observed by aircraft. E.g. VFR and/or IFR.

codeTypeFreq.d: Type of special frequency used by a service.

codeTypeGeoBdr.d: The type of geograpfical border. The most common situation is the border between two countries.

codeTypeHoldProc.d: A code indicating the type of holding procedure. E.g. en-route holding, terminal area holding.

codeTypeHrNavAid.d: A code indicating the type of schedule a timesheet is describing. E.g. working hours, un-monitored hours.

codeTypeIap.d: A code indicating the type of the Instrument Approach Procedure. E.g. Approach Transition, VOR/DME Approach, Instrument Landing System (ILS), NDB Approach, GPS Approach.

v.FLOOD: Flood light. [note: This indicates that the light source contains a large powerful lamp that produces a strong broad beam of artificial light and is used to illuminate the outside at night. .]
v.STROBE: Strobe light. [note: This indicates that the light source contains a high intensity flashing beam of light produced by charging a capacitor to a very high voltage then discharging it as a high-intensity flash of light in a tube. .]

codeTypeLight.d: A code indicating a type of light source, such as strobe or flood.

codeTypeMilOps.d: A code indicating if a facility is to be used for military, civil or both types of operations.

codeTypeNavAidLimit.d: A code indicating the type of radio navigation aid limitation.

codeTypeNavCkPt.d: A code indicating the type of navigation system for which the checkpoint has been established. E.g. INS, VOR, GNSS, etc..

v.LHNG: Low and high pressure nitrogen servicing.
v.NG: Indicates nitrogen servicing when type of servicing is unspecified.

codeTypeNitrogen.d: A code describing the type of nitrogen supplies for aviation usage.

v.GRID: The direction of the north-south lines of the Universal Transverse Mercator (UTM) grid imposed on topographic maps by the United States and NATO.

codeTypeNorth.d: A code indicating the type of the North reference used.

codeTypeOpsRwy.d: A code indicating the type of operation performed using a runway direction. E.g. approach or take-off.

codeTypeOrg.d: A code indicating the type of an Organisation/Authority. Ex: State, Association of States, International Organisation, etc..

v.LHOX: Low and high pressure oxygen servicing.
v.OX: Indicates oxygen servicing when type of servicing is unspecified.

codeTypeOxygen.d: A code describing the type of oxygen supplies for aviation usage.

codeTypePaxFac.d: A code indicating a type of passenger facility available. E.g. hotels, restaurants, transportation, medical service, etc.

v.AF: (ARINC) constant DME arc to a fix.
v.HF: (ARINC) hold pattern terminating at a fix after one circuit.
v.HA: (ARINC) hold pattern term. at fix after reach. an altitude.
v.PI: (ARINC) procedure turn followed by a course to a fix (CF).
v.PT: (non ARINC) timed outbound leg to a procedure turn.
v.CI: (ARINC) course to next leg followed by course oriented leg.
v.DF: (ARINC) Computed track direct to a fix.
v.FA: (ARINC) course from a fix to an altitude.
v.FC: (ARINC) course from a fix to a distance.
v.FT: (non ARINC) course from a fix during a specified time.
v.FM: (ARINC) course from a fix to a manual termination.
v.FD: (ARINC) course from a fix to a DME distance.

codeTypeProcPath.d: A code that defines a specific type of flight path and a specific type of termination of that flight path. Although we agree with the ARINC idea that procedures should be designed with the aim to permit FMS equipped aircraft to fly tracks instead of procedural headings, for the time being we must allow all representation of these procedures (especially reversal procedures) as they are published by the States. This is the explanation of the differences between the allowable values for attributes in this domain and the ARINC leg types.

codeTypeProtectAreaFato.d: A code indicating the type of protection area for a FATO. E.g. clearway, ILS protection area, safety area, etc..

codeTypeProtectAreaRwy.d: A code indicating the type of protection area for a runway E.g. clearway, obstacle free zone, ILS protection area, etc..

codeTypeRelAs.d: A code indicating how the two airspace are associated together.

codeTypeRestr.d: A code indicating if the restriction is an interdiction or a mandatory routing.

codeTypeRte.d: The type of the route from the navigation point of view. E.g. conventional, RNAV, etc..

codeTypeSegPath.d: A code indicating the type of segment path.

codeTypeSer.d: Type of a service such as Flight Information etc.

codeTypeSerAd.d: A code indicating the type of ground service at an aerodrome/heliport. E.g. customs, immigration, health and sanitation, handling, security, de-icing, hangaring, repairing, rescue, disabled aircraft removal, fire fighting, clearing, fuelling.

codeTypeSerSpecNav.d: A code indicating the type of service provided by a station in a special navigation system chain, depending on the type of the system.

codeTypeSid.d: A code indicating a type of Standard Instrument Departure (SID). E.g. SID, RNAV SID, Engine out SID or FMS SID.

v.DECCA: Short and medium range (area) navigation system DECCA.

codeTypeSpecNavSys.d: A code indicating a type of special navigation system. E.g. LORAN, DECCA, GNSS, etc.

codeTypeStand.d: A code indicating the type of stand. E.g. parking position on the apron, isolated aircraft stand, terminal building gate, etc..

codeTypeStar.d: A code indicating a type of Standard Arival Route (STAR): convetional, RNAV, FMS.

codeTypeTimetable.d: A code indicating the type of timetable (working hours, activation hours) associated with a specific activity.

codeTypeTlofVertex.d: A code indicating the type of path to the next point of a TLOF related area. E.g. line, circle, clockwise arc, counter clockwise arc, etc.

codeTypeTwy.d: A code indicating a type of taxiway. E.g. normal taxiway, apron taxiway, air taxiway, etc..

v.BOF: Briefing office (note: Note ICAO listed by nonetheless used.)
v.MIL: Military station/unit (or military office in general).
v.MILOPS: Planning/briefing office for military flight operations.

codeTypeUnit.d: A unit providing particular ATS services.

codeTypeUseBackIls.d: A code indicating the usability of the localizer signal in the back-course sector.

v.AVASIS: Abbreviated visual approach slow indicator system.
v.PVASI: Pulsating/steady burning visual approach slope indicator, normally a single light unit projecting two colours.
v.TRCV: Tri-colour visual approach slope indicator, normally a single light unit projecting three colours.
v.ILU: A number of identical light units.
v.OLS: Optical landing system for strip decks and aircraft carriers (sometimes available on ground air bases for training purposes).
v.LCVASI: Low cost visual approach slope indicator: 3 sets of 4 white lights on 3 mounts usually on only one side of the runway.

codeTypeVasis.d: A code indicating a type of visual approach slope indicator system. Eg: VASIS, AVASIS, 3-BAR VASIS, PAPI, APAPI, etc..

codeTypeVertex.d: A code indicating the type of path to the next point. E.g. great circle, rhumbline, geoidal line, clockwise arc, counter clockwise arc, etc.

codeTypeVor.d: A code indicating the type of VOR, e.g. conventional VOR or Doppler VOR.

codeUsageLimitation.d: A code indicating whether a limitation is of type permission, interdiction or exclusive usage

codeYesNo.d: A code for a logical value: Yes or No.

uomDistHorz.d: A unit of measurement for a horizontal distance. E.g. metres, feet, nautical miles, kilometres, etc. .

v.FL: Flight level in hundreds of feet.
v.SM: Standard metric level (in tens of meters).

uomDistVer.d: A unit of measurement for a vertical distance. E.g. Flight Level, metres, feet.

uomDur.d: A unit of measurement for time. E.g. seconds, minutes, hours.

uomElev.d: A unit of measurement for an elevation. E.g. metres or feet.

uomFreq.d: A unit of measurement for a frequency. E.g. Hz, kHz, MHz,GHz.

uomPressure.d: A unit of measurement for pressure values.

uomSpeed.d: A unit of measurement for speed.

uomT.d: A unit of measurement for temperature.

uomWeight.d: A unit of measurement for weight values.
